References: Pan115Api, Pan115Constants, Pan115Crypto, Pan123Api,
Pan123Constants, C139Api, C139Constants and QuarkApi interface descriptions.
These references describe endpoint paths, request fields, response shapes,
protocol constants, signatures, and encryption framing used by the providers.
CloudDownloader implements native Rust adapters for these wire protocols;
the release does not include or run YunX-Desktop binaries or Kotlin sources.

115 direct share endpoint reference:
https://github.com/AlistGo/alist/issues/5384

Protocol test fixtures contain synthetic account IDs, file IDs and URLs.
They are verified locally and do not establish live provider compatibility.
